features.feature: Story-level declaration path for generated delivery artifacts (artifact_declare CLI command)
Idempotent re-declaration (same path second call = overwrite, not duplicate)
Path validation / rejection of unsafe paths (*, **, leading slash, .. components)
Distinguish expected product outputs from unexpected dirty files in dirty ownership classifier
declared_artifact_changes category visible in koala session_brief and koala validate output
Undeclared generated files remain blocking (conservative default preserved)
Declared artifacts must be referenced by verificationEvidence or delivery-check to pass DONE gate
DONE pre-check [unreferenced_declared_artifact] blocker for declared-but-unreferenced artifacts
Reference check validates intentRef actually exists in checklist verificationIntent
Empty declared-artifacts.json does not trigger DONE gate
Regression coverage using BL21 lacZ viewer output path as concrete example

DONE gate requires evidence freshness / validation evidence to pass (decisions/story-lifecycle.md)
verificationEvidence kind options: logic_test, integration_test, browser_test, manual_transcript, docs_check, waiver (decisions/testing-infra.md)
koala validate test coverage / integration test suite for new artifact feature (decisions/testing-infra.md)
flow function @flow annotation and end-to-end flow test requirements (decisions/testing-completeness.md)
